column1: # AGNES LEIBHOLZ née KERGER — NOT FOUND, AND THE SEARCH IS NOW BOUNDED INSTEAD OF OPEN.
# Worked 8 October 2026, after the twelve-borough West Berlin sweep failed to produce her.
# Work list rows 245, 252, 253.
# WHAT SHE IS. One of the four Leibholz women row 245 named. The other three now have a candidate and a
# register number. SHE DOES NOT, AND THIS FILE IS THE HONEST ACCOUNT OF WHY.
field
# ---------------- WHAT WAS GAINED: A BIRTHPLACE, AND A SOURCE NUMBER ----------------
*** BORN 10 MARCH 1889 AT MALLMITZ, KREIS SPROTTAU, SILESIA ***
column2: Mapping the Lives, read at the source on 8 October rather than taken from the one line this archive had copied out of it. THE ARCHIVE HELD ONLY THE DATE. Mallmitz is today MAŁOMICE in powiat żagański, Lubusz, POLAND; Sprottau is Szprotawa. It is about 160 km south-east of Berlin and it has not been in Germany since 1945 — SO WHATEVER HAPPENED TO HER AFTER 1980, SHE HAD NO HOME REGION TO RETURN TO.

column1: *** AND HER CENSUS CARD HAS A NUMBER: VZ153403 ***
column2: Bundesarchiv R 1509, Reichssippenamt, the supplementary card to the census of 17 May 1939. That is a citable document identifier this archive did not have for her.

column1: RACE: NNNN, BASIS OF PERSECUTION: COLLECTIVE
column2: FOUR NON-JEWISH GRANDPARENTS. She is in a database of the persecuted ONLY BY MARRIAGE — she was the "Aryan" wife and Heinrich the Jewish husband. That is why she has no deportation record, no Gedenkbuch entry and no Yad Vashem page, and it is why the instruments that find this family's dead do not reach her.

column1: her residence on census night
column2: Leinestraße 32, III. rechts, Neukölln, with Heinrich. HE IS GIVEN A DEATH — 9 AUGUST 1948 — AND SHE IS NOT. The database carries no death for her at all.

column1: # ---------------- WHAT WAS ELIMINATED, AND IT IS MOST OF BERLIN ----------------
*** SHE DID NOT DIE IN WEST BERLIN BETWEEN 1967 AND 1994 ***
column2: All twelve boroughs are now read for the surname — Schöneberg, Kreuzberg, Reinickendorf, Spandau, Neukölln on 7 October and Charlottenburg, Steglitz, Tempelhof, Tiergarten, Wedding, Wilmersdorf, Zehlendorf on 8 October, 244 volumes between them, every page of every volume, with six blind volumes read at the image.

column1: AND THE YEAR COVERAGE WAS VERIFIED RATHER THAN ASSUMED
column2: *** A MISSING VOLUME IS INVISIBLE: a sweep reports what it read, not what it should have read. *** Every borough's volume list was laid against the years 1967 to 1994 one year at a time. ELEVEN ARE COMPLETE WITHOUT A GAP. NEUKÖLLN HAS NO DEATH INDEX FOR 1993 OR 1994 — LABSA simply holds none — and that is the only hole in the whole sweep. Agnes would have been 104 in 1993, so it is a hole and not an explanation, but it is recorded as a hole.

column1: *** AND THE THREE MOST LIKELY VOLUMES IN BERLIN WERE RE-SCORED BEFORE BEING TRUSTED ***
column2: she leaves the Berlin telephone book between 1979-80 and 1980-81, so KREUZBERG 1980, 1981 AND 1982 — her own borough, in the exact window — are where she should be. Those three were read on 21 September BEFORE the legibility control existed, and Kreuzberg 1983 later turned out to be BLIND. If 1980-82 were blind too, their negatives were worthless and the whole search was resting on nothing. THEY WERE RESCORED ON 8 OCTOBER: 1.717, 1.480 and 0.341 common surnames a page against a floor of 0.15. ALL THREE ARE LEGIBLE AND THE NEGATIVES STAND.

column1: one caveat stated rather than buried
column2: KREUZBERG 1982 SCORES 0.341, which passes but is the WEAKEST LEGIBLE VOLUME IN EITHER SWEEP — four to five times thinner than its own neighbours. It is the 226-page volume holding TWO alphabetical sequences, so the density is diluted by its own size, and this archive read it at the image in September as well. Recorded so that if Agnes ever turns up in 1982, nobody has to wonder whether the instrument was warned.

column1: # ---------------- AND ONE NEW NEGATIVE THAT IS ITSELF A LEAD ----------------
*** HEINRICH LEIBHOLZ IS NOT IN NEUKÖLLN'S DEATH INDEX FOR 1948, ALTHOUGH HE LIVED THERE ***
column2: P Rep. 380 Nr. 700, the 1948-1950 volume, 782 pages and NO TEXT LAYER AT ALL. Read at the image: the L block for 1948 is PAGES 357 TO 371, opening under a JANUAR heading on 357 and running through an AUGUST heading on 367, an OKTOBER on 369 and a DEZEMBER on 371. *** THERE IS NO LEIBHOLZ IN ANY OF IT, AND NONE UNDER AUGUST. ***

column1: why that is not a contradiction but a direction
column2: A DEATH REGISTERS WHERE IT HAPPENS, NOT WHERE THE DEAD PERSON LIVED. Mapping the Lives gives Heinrich's address as Leinestraße 32 — that is his RESIDENCE on census night 1939, not his place of death. He died on 9 August 1948 somewhere outside Neukölln's district, which for a man of fifty-seven most likely means a hospital in another borough.

column1: WHAT THAT BUYS FOR AGNES
column2: HIS DEATH ENTRY NAMES THE SURVIVING WIDOW AND USUALLY HER ADDRESS. Finding it would place Agnes in 1948 and give the borough the family actually used — and this archive has never had a single document about her beyond a census card and a directory line. THE JOB IS BOUNDED: the 1948 death index of the eleven other West Berlin boroughs, which is one volume each.

column1: # ---------------- WHERE SHE CAN STILL BE, STATED PLAINLY ----------------
she died after 1994
column2: The indexes stop at 1994 because the protection period is thirty years and the window moves one year at a time. She would have been 105. POSSIBLE AND UNLIKELY, and it resolves itself: the 1995 volumes become public in 2026 and the 1996 in 2027.

column1: she died outside Berlin
column2: The likeliest of the three. A woman of ninety-one leaving a telephone book may have gone to a relative or a home in the Federal Republic, and there is NO NATIONAL GERMAN DEATH INDEX to search. Nothing held here points at a destination.

column1: she died in East Berlin
column2: Twelve further offices and 467 volumes, deliberately not swept. A West Berliner listed at Mehringdamm 109 in 1979-80 did not move to the DDR, and sweeping 30 GB to say so would be thoroughness for its own sake.

column1: *** WHAT THIS FILE WILL NOT DO ***
column2: assert that she died in 1980 or 1981 because that is when the telephone stopped. THIS ARCHIVE'S OWN CONTROL FORBIDS IT AND THE CONTROL IS HER HUSBAND: HEINRICH VANISHED FROM THE BERLIN DIRECTORY AFTER 1942 AND DID NOT DIE UNTIL 1948, SIX YEARS LATER. Leaving a book is not dying, and in this household it has already been wrong once by six years.
